EmailTemplate.description: OAL formal template for Case Claims CRM-6589
EmailTemplate.name: Freight Email To Case Claims - OAL Formal
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Subject} - Qantas Freight Customer Support - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for reaching out to Qantas Freight.
Formal claims must be submitted directly with airline that issued the AWB. As this claim related to an airline that we offer ground handling service for, you will need to redirect this claim directly to the issuing airline.
Should the airline require any handling information they will reach out to us directly. Please liaise with the airline directly for any further updates.
All the best, Qantas Freight Team www.qantasfreight.com
